1. (Currently amended) A system for providing security in a computer system, the system comprising:
a ring oscillator-based entropy source configured to generate a plurality of independent first entropy values;
one or more logic circuits operatively coupled to the entropy source and configured to:
receive the plurality of independent first entropy values from the ring oscillator-based entropy source;
apply at least some of the plurality of independent first entropy values to a function to generate a second entropy value, wherein the function includes countermeasures to phase tracking attacks;
seed a pseudorandom number generator with the second entropy value;
generate a random number using the pseudorandom number generator seeded with the second entropy value; and
produce a block of ciphertext or message authentication code using the random number.

2. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the one or more logic circuits being configured to produce the block of ciphertext or message authentication code includes being configured to produce the block of ciphertext or message authentication code with a key composed of or derived from the random number, wherein the key generation includes countermeasures to phase tracking attacks.

3. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the one or more logic circuits being configured to produce the block of ciphertext or message authentication code includes being configured to at least:
implement a key-agreement protocol using the random number and in which a key is produced; and
produce the block of ciphertext or message authentication code using the key, wherein the key-agreement protocol includes countermeasures to phase tracking attacks.

4. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the ring oscillator-based entropy source comprises at least one ring oscillator configured to generate the plurality of independent first entropy values with countermeasures to phase tracking attacks.

5. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the ring oscillator-based entropy source is a single ring oscillator, and the one or more logic circuits being configured to receive the plurality of independent first entropy values includes being configured to receive the plurality of independent first entropy values from the single ring oscillator.

6. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the ring oscillator-based entropy source comprises a plurality of independent ring oscillators, and the one or more logic circuits being configured to receive the plurality of independent first entropy values includes being configured to receive the plurality of independent first entropy values from the plurality of independent ring oscillators.

7. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the function is a permutation function, and the one or more logic circuits being configured to apply at least some of the plurality of independent first entropy values to the function includes being configured to apply at least some of the plurality of independent first entropy values to the permutation function, wherein the permutation function includes countermeasures to phase tracking attacks.

8. (Currently amended) The system of claim 7, wherein the one or more logic circuits being configured to apply at least some of the plurality of independent first entropy values to the function includes being configured to:
divide the plurality of independent first entropy values into multiple groups of independent first entropy values;
apply the multiple groups of independent first entropy values to the permutation function to generate permuted groups of entropy values; and
concatenate the permuted groups of entropy values to generate the second entropy value, wherein the permutation function includes countermeasures to phase tracking attacks.

9. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the function is a hash function, and the one or more logic circuits being configured to apply at least some of the plurality of independent first entropy values to the function includes being configured to apply at least some of the plurality of independent first entropy values to the hash function, wherein the hash function includes countermeasures to phase tracking attacks.

10. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the function is a bit-mixer, and the one or more logic circuits being configured to apply at least some of the plurality of independent first entropy values to the function includes being configured to apply at least some of the plurality of independent first entropy values to the bit-mixer, wherein the bit-mixer includes countermeasures to phase tracking attacks.

11. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the one or more logic circuits being configured to apply at least some of the plurality of independent first entropy values to the function includes being configured to selectively apply multiple entropy values of the plurality of independent first entropy values to the function to generate the second entropy value, wherein the selective application includes countermeasures to phase tracking attacks.
